acceptance: Consume only authenticated terminal shadow candidates for the configured tenant and ignore proposed, claimed, failed, degraded, or foreign-tenant candidates.
Create exactly one governed Consultation request per candidate using a durable idempotency key.
Persist dataset version, Agora handoff, candidate, tenant/user, trace, and request identifiers without granting runtime or promotion authority.
Allow the existing Consultation executor to produce a terminal memo/handoff; do not fork or duplicate its workflow implementation.
Send intake failures to a bounded durable retry/DLQ path and prove replay produces one request, not duplicates.
Prove a second tenant cannot enumerate, create, replay, or read the first tenant's candidate-derived Consultation records.
